subject: FoodTech POS v4.2.2 software update stuck at 67% installation on Terminal 1
description: The POS terminal (POS-0054-T1) at ServeWell Thane West initiated an automatic software update to FoodTech POS v4.2.2 at approximately 16:45 IST on 2025-11-22. The update process has been frozen at 67% completion for over 20 minutes with no progress. The terminal displays a white progress bar with the message "Installing FoodTech POS v4.2.2... 67% Complete" but does not advance further. The system is unresponsive to keyboard and touchscreen inputs, preventing any order processing or customer transactions. Attempted troubleshooting steps include: (1) waiting an additional 10 minutes to allow background processes to complete, (2) attempting a soft restart by pressing the power button once (no effect—screen remains locked on update screen), and (3) checking the network connection which appears stable. This terminal handles approximately 40% of peak-hour transactions during lunch service, and the outage is directly impacting customer service capacity. The store manager estimates a business impact of ₹2,500–₹3,500 in lost transaction volume if the issue persists beyond 18:30 IST. Asset information confirmed: Terminal 1 (POS-0054-T1) running FoodTech POS v4.2.2 with Intel processor, 4GB RAM, and standard configuration. No error codes are currently visible on the frozen screen.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Advised store manager to attempt a hard restart (hold power button for 10 seconds) and monitor for recovery. Follow-up scheduled in 15 minutes.

Hard restart attempted by store manager; update screen persists at 67%. No improvement observed. Issue appears to require backend intervention or manual update process. Escalation to L2 recommended pending technical review.
